description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of Land in Heenkenda, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Compensation for the acquisition of Land Mattumagala Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding land acquisitions for the state, including specific details about land locations, plot numbers, extents, and compensation deposits. The content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
